### Day 221: John 19:38–42
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-221-john-19-3842.html
Passage: John 19:41
Points:
- Experiencing profound loss and death often brings intense, disorienting grief.
- While the world sees death as the end, in God's economy death brings true hope.
- Surrendering our grief to the faithful Creator keeps emotional pain from destroying us.
- The final stage of Christian grief is not mere resignation, but receiving God's resurrection life.

### Joseph and Nicodemus Bury Jesus
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/joseph-and-nicodemus-bury-jesus
Passage: John 19:38-42
Points:
- Joseph of Arimathea and Nicodemus initially hid their discipleship out of fear.
- Caring for the Lord's body served as a brave, public declaration of their faith.
- Jesus was spared a criminal's grave and received an honorable burial in a new tomb.
- The honor shown at His burial marked the shift from His humiliation toward exaltation.
- Believers tempted to hide their faith must repent and openly identify with Christ.
